issue_request: FHIR-23936 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core R5 and asked the Mapping Language evaluate transform to document how FHIRPath collection results are applied to target creation: empty results create no target element, single results create one target value, multiple results create separate repeating target instances when allowed, and multiple results against a non-repeating target are an error.
initial_application: The issue was directly applied by commit 7a3e9c0df7f896fe575eceaf0d5112b97159d3bb, which added the requested collection-cardinality prose to source/mapping-language.html. The current source still retains that wording in the evaluate transform row.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2019-12-16 record the Persuasive 11-0-0 motion for FHIR-23936 and summarize the empty/single/multiple-result behavior; the final Jira resolution contains the fuller repeating-target exception now present in source. source/hierarchy.xml lists mapping-language.html as an active page, and the page is also linked from implementation-support and documentation pages. Later related mapping-language changes, including FHIR-23937 and FHIR-46548, did not supersede or alter the FHIR-23936 collection-handling rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because source/mapping-language.html already states the final FHIR-23936 behavior in active build-scope content.
